t: This is Moorfields, a street in the City of London. The material I have is thin, but it names several people connected with it, many of them from the Society of Friends, the Quakers. Robert Dring, an early Familist and Quaker who lived from 1617 to 1697, was born here. Amor Stoddard, a Quaker who lived from 1653 to 1670, lived here from 1670. And Thomas Smith, a merchant and the first recorder of the British and Foreign Bible Society, also lived here.
